name: Berg Earth
summary: Operating within the agricultural sector, Berg Earth Co.,Ltd. specializes in the cultivation and distribution of vegetable seedlings across Japan. A primary focus for the company is providing grafted saplings for a diverse range of fruit and vegetable crops. Furthermore, Berg Earth Co.,Ltd. extends its business into the home gardening market and supplies various agricultural materials. The firm was established in 2001 and its main offices are located in Uwajima, Japan.
